Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL4818987. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4818987'. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return all columns including null SMILES. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
